High school diploma PLUS a minimum of 10 years of related work experience in cardiac mapping and navigation.

Strong knowledge of the machine learning model lifecycle and MLOps practices, including model development, training, validation, versioning, deployment, monitoring, reproducibility, and lifecycle management.

Experience with machine learning frameworks and technologies such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent technologies.

Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and operating cloud-native and distributed software systems.

Experience building and improving reusable platform services, automation, CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, APIs, and self-service engineering capabilities.

Strong hands-on experience developing software solutions in Python, with the ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code for production environments.

Demonstrated ability to independently solve difficult, moderately complex, and undefined technical problems through detailed information gathering, analysis, investigation, and sound engineering judgment.

Demonstrated ability to make moderate to significant improvements to processes, systems, products, or engineering practices that measurably improve performance of the job area.

Experience leading major or moderately complex technical projects, including planning and coordinating work, managing dependencies, delegating activities, reviewing work products, and providing technical leadership.

Demonstrated ability to provide guidance, coaching, and training to other engineers and raise technical capability across a team or engineering organization.

Experience troubleshooting complex production systems, performing root-cause analysis, and implementing solutions and lasting systemic improvements.

Strong communication and influence skills, with demonstrated ability to represent an organization as a primary technical contact and collaborate with internal teams, customers, external partners, and vendors at multiple levels.

Demonstrated ability to negotiate, build consensus, and influence technical decision-making across teams and organizational boundaries.

Broad knowledge of principles and practices sufficient to lead complex technical initiatives from planning through implementation and adoption.

Experience or familiarity with one or more of the following will provide a strong foundation for success:

Experience running and monitoring Machine Learning models in a production environment.

Experience with building backend applications on public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or GCP.

Deep understanding and practical experience with containerization technologies like Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm.

Familiarity with event streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka or comparable technologies.

Experience configuring observation tools such as Dynatrace, ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, or comparable technologies for monitoring applications.
